//: Claude Code MCP servers (guide/10-mcp.md). Merge the servers you want into your CLI settings' mcpServers block. PLACEHOLDERS ONLY — no real tokens (use ${ENV_VAR}) and no real paths (use $HOME-relative). Enable only what a project needs.

mcpServers.//github: GitHub's OFFICIAL MCP server (github/github-mcp-server). A capability grant: scope with --toolsets + use --read-only to gate mutations (guide/09-permissions.md). PAT from the environment, never inline. NOTE: the old community @modelcontextprotocol/server-github is deprecated/archived (Apr 2025) — use this. Two modes: (a) LOCAL binary below (brew install github-mcp-server, or Docker ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server), PAT auth; (b) REMOTE hosted at https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ (OAuth) — see mcp/README.md.
mcpServers.//filesystem: Scoped file access. List ONLY the directories the work needs — NEVER $HOME root and NEVER a secret-bearing path.
mcpServers.//optional-docs: Optional: a docs/context fetcher so the operator cites current docs, not training memory.
mcpServers.//optional-browser: Optional: browser automation for tasks with no API (guide/11-agents-skills.md). Enable per project.
